items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Well, I played with him... And me and Johnny Dots fight every night.

ctx.x: Well, I played with him and I said, oh, man, can't you stay with us? I said, well, I'll think about it. You know, I was particular. Because you know, I'd be down, down, down, down, in the red light, you know, and around this ship. Finally, I said, alright. I stayed with him. And that's how it happened. That's great. Them guys used to get a deposit on the job and everybody get, they had everybody something but be, because I never wanted to. I said, give it to them boys. I didn't, you know. And lots of times we'd…
Over the music or something? Yeah, over the music, anything.
